events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: On the bench. Don't tell me what it does, I'll feel what it does. Two dollars. I don't come down for anybody, Dunwoody included.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: Sear was cut short at the factory. Fouling only made it show its hand early. Cycle it. Hear that? That's the sound it should have made the day somebody sold it to you.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: You paid what I asked and didn't work at me first. That happens maybe three times in a year. I'll bring the bench and my own files.

events.speaker: RILLA
events.text: A mechanism running true is about the only thing I've ever been plainly glad about. You aren't made of steel and I've caught myself glad anyhow. Make of that what you want.
